scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@tiffin/shared && npm run build --workspace=@tiffin/api && npm run build --workspace=@tiffin/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace=@tiffin/shared && npm run build --workspace=@tiffin/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace=@tiffin/shared && npm run build --workspace=@tiffin/web
